scope: Deterministic actual source endpoint/actor/Binder callback tests under Robolectric. No claim of native receiver audio-engine or car acceptance.
observations: Ready owner refuses parked reset without revoking its retained announcement authority.
Parked reset preserves current visual state, removes earlier playback authorities, invalidates old snapshot ACKs and eventually notifies a receiver whose event callback was busy.
A granted attempt whose lease expires while its callback is busy retains OWNER_REVOKED until delivery can resume; the source still refuses another audio claim with AUDIO_UNCERTAIN.
